answer: Australia has about 27.9 million people. That's the Australian Bureau of Statistics official estimate for 31 March 2026, after the population grew 1.4% over the previous year [1]. Canada has about 41 million, so it has roughly 13 million more people, about 1.5 times as many. Australia is growing fast, mostly because of immigration: about three-quarters of its most recent annual increase came from net overseas migration [1][2].

sources.title: Australia's population grows 1.4 per cent in one year, ABS says (ABC News)
